name: Ubel
source:
A group of eight are kidnapped by an unknown individual and are locked inside a high-tech facility. They are forced to vote for a victim every two hours until they manage to find and destroy the AI ruling over the facility. Will they succeed before death becomes imminent?

The story follows Player, who wakes up in his cell without his memory. The occasional flashbacks he's having do more harm than good in the grim state of affairs. The facility contains many rooms filled with puzzles, which the player and the others must solve to get more information about their whereabouts.

With no hints to what is going on and with dangerous collars around their throats, the group can only follow the instructions given to them. Who is behind this? What is their purpose? Is the culprit among the cast? Are they the only ones there?

[from the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/regularjax/ubel-mystery-thriller-visual-novel]Kickstarter page[/url]]
translation:
八人小组被身份不明的人绑架，并被锁在高科技设施内。他们被迫每两个小时投票选出一名受害者，直到他们设法找到并摧毁对该设施的人工智能统治。他们会在死亡来临之前成功吗？

故事围绕玩家展开，他在牢房中醒来，失去了记忆。在严峻的形势下，他偶尔的回忆弊大于利。该设施包含许多充满谜题的房间，玩家和其他人必须解决这些谜题才能获得有关其行踪的更多信息。

由于没有任何线索表明发生了什么，而且他们的喉咙上戴着危险的项圈，这群人只能遵循给他们的指示。这背后是谁？他们的目的是什么？罪魁祸首是演员吗？他们是那里唯一的人吗？

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/regularjax/ubel-mystery-thriller-visual-novel]Kickstarter页面[/url]]
